title: analytics: the draft preview answers $contains on a multi-value field as a substring of the stringified array, not membership
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5miLqNucRZevceHwNh

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by seat 4 area a4-C's dev on #36168 (os-dev report 7068861732), raised to a card by L1-a's record 7069360733 on PR #36184.

## What happens
The analytics draft preview (`POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query?preview=draft`, the face Studio's preview mode reads) evaluates `$contains` as a case-folded substring of `String(value)`. On a multi-value field (`multiple: true`, or an inherently multi-value type) the stored array is stringified, so `$contains: 'a'` matches a row holding `['ab']`, `$contains: 'end'` matches `['frontend']`, `$contains: 'A'` matches `['a']`, and `$contains: 'a,b'` matches `['a','b']`. The data door, the native SQL strategy and the ObjectQL strategy answer `$contains` on such a column as membership (#20987), so the preview counts rows the published dataset does not.

## Where
`packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts`, the `$contains` entry of the operator table (`String(value ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(...)`); after PR #36184 the same file already refuses the JSON-column comparison set through `json-column-comparison-refusal.ts`, which holds the declared-column resolver this fix needs.

## Done when
On the draft preview, `$contains` (and `$notContains`) on a declared multi-value field is membership, matching the native strategy's answer for the same filter; a pin covers a substring-only value, a case-only difference and a comma-joined value, with a scalar text control. Whether the preview's case fold on a scalar text `$contains` is also a mismatch (the case-exact family, #4706 Q2 = A) is read, not measured: the dev checks it and either fixes it here or names why it differs.

reach: public HTTP door `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query?preview=draft`, read from code (mechanism named above), not measured; real producer: Studio's preview mode (`MetadataProvider` preview reads).
Business reason: an author previewing a dashboard or dataset filtered on a multi-value field sees counts that change after publish, with no error; they tune the filter against wrong numbers.
Reader: a domain:server lane (analytics draft preview).
Dedupe: `preview contains multi-value` → 3 hits, `preview-evaluator` → 33 hits, `draft preview contains substring` → 19 hits; open: #36168 (comparison set, not `$contains`) and #35873 (share-grant leaf, different mechanism); the rest closed.
Grade: p2 · area:reports · Bug · silent wrong count on a preview face only (the published door answers right) · reach read · evidence read.
